meaning:
ὄφελος, -ονς, τό
(ὀφέλλω, to increase) [in LXX: Job.15:3 (יָעַל hi.)* ;]
advantage, help: 1Co.15:32, Jas.2:14, 16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?
